_published_faq.name: How do I add ANYMARKET-MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ANYMARKET-MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.anymarket.com.br/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is ANYMARKET-MCP MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, ANYMARKET-MCP scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ANYMARKET-MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ANYMARKET-MCP lists 48 MCP tools, including anymarket_brands_get, anymarket_brands_list, anymarket_brands_marketplace_list, anymarket_callbacks_get, anymarket_callbacks_list, anymarket_campaigns_get, anymarket_campaigns_list, anymarket_campaigns_products_list, anymarket_categories_get, anymarket_categories_list, anymarket_categories_tree, and anymarket_fiscal_documents_get.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ANYMARKET-MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ANYMARKET-MCP in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
ANYMARKET-MCP does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
